Advisory

Advisory for leadership teams

For leadership teams starting or scaling AI agents, and deciding how far to trust them.

Advisory areas

  1. Autonomy readiness assessment
  2. Governance and guardrail design
  3. Operating-model changes
  4. Business case and 30-month roadmap

How an engagement works

  1. Intro callA conversation about where you are with AI agents and what your leadership team needs to decide.
  2. Readiness assessmentAn autonomy readiness assessment of the processes, systems and controls in scope.
  3. Roadmap and guardrailsA business case, a 30-month roadmap and the guardrails your agents will run inside.

Tell the intake agent what you need

An AI agent asks a few short questions and fills in a request card. You can edit the card. Nothing is sent until you agree and press Send.

No JavaScript, or the agent is resting? Email Hemanth at regantih@gmail.com.
